definitions.full: H4443. Malkiram מַלְכִּירָם proper name, masculine son of Jeconiah (= Jehoiakin) ( my king (= Yahweh) is high , compare Gray Prop. N. 146 f. ; Phoenician proper name מלכרם ); — 1Chr 3:18 . ᵐ5 Μελχ ( ε ) ιραμ .
definitions.rootNote: from 4428 and 7311 ; king of a high one (i.e. of exaltation);

occurrences.englishText: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
